description: Moves one session on the agenda of an event the person organizes to a new start time or room ("push the keynote to 4:30 PM"). Pass holders are notified unless `notify` is false. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm` returns a PREVIEW with a `changeId`, the before and after, how many pass holders would be notified and the notice, and changes nothing; read it back, and only when they say yes call again with `confirm: true` and that `changeId`. Name the session by `sessionId` or title; on AMBIGUOUS or NO_SUCH_SESSION read the candidates back and ask. Only the organizer of the event can change it; anybody else is refused, read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

at.description: Optional current start ("10:30 AM"), for sessions sharing a title.

confirm.description: Leave out for the preview; after the organizer says yes, true with the changeId.

end.description: Optional new end; else it keeps its length.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

notify.description: Optional; false keeps the move quiet.

sessionId.description: The session id as the agenda gave it.

sessionTitle.description: Or the session title, when there is no sessionId.

start.description: New start, "4:30 PM" or a timestamp, in the event's time zone.

name: event_session_move
title: Move a session to a new time or room (organizers only)
